name: OMathMatRows
description: Represents a collection of matrix rows. Use the OMathMatRow object to access individual members of the collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathMatRows object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the OMathMatRows collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an OMathMatRow object that represents the specified item in the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies the ordinal position of the object within the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Creates an equation row and adds it to a matrix and returns an OMathMatRow object.

parameters.name: BeforeRow
parameters.description: An existing row in the matrix before which to place the new row.
